def _generate_pattern_re(self, fmt: str) -> Tuple[List[_FORMAT_TYPE], Pattern[str]]:
    ef = re.escape(fmt)
    ef = re.sub(self._ESCAPE_RE, "#", ef)
    ef = re.sub(r"S+", "S", ef)

    fp = ef

            raise ParserError(f"Unrecognized token {tok!r}.")
        ir = self._input_re_map[tok]
        ip = f"(?P<{tok}>{ir.pattern})"
        fp = fp[:m.start()+off] + ip + fp[m.end()+off:]
        off += len(ip) - (m.end() - m.start())
        toks.append(tok)
    parts = fp.split(r"\#")
    ffp = "".join(
        parts[i] + (ed[i][1:-1] if i < len(ed) else "")
        for i in range(len(parts))

    swb = (

        r"(?<![^\,\.\;\:\?\!\"\'\`\[\]\{\}\(\)<>\s])"
        r"(\b|^)"

    ewb = (

    )

    ef = re.escape(fmt)

        fp = fp[:m.start()+off] + ip + fp[m.end()+off:]

        toks.append(tok)
    parts = fp.split(r"\#")
    ffp = "".join(
        parts[i] + (ed[i][1:-1] if i < len(ed) else "")
        for i in range(len(parts))
    )
    swb = (
        r"(?<!\S\S)"
        r"(?<![^\,\.\;\:\?\!\"\'\`\[\]\{\}\(\)<>\s])"
        r"(\b|^)"

    ewb = (

    )
